questions.stem: A substance has a low melting point, does not conduct electricity, and is a gas at room temperature. What type of structure does it have?
questions.explanation: This describes a simple molecular substance. Simple molecular substances have low melting points because the intermolecular forces between molecules are weak. They do not conduct electricity because they have no charged particles. Many simple molecular substances are gases at room temperature because the weak intermolecular forces are easily overcome.
